snapshots.name: listParcels
snapshots.sql: select "parcels"."id", "parcels"."parcel_code", "parcels"."merchant_id", "merchants"."shop_name", "parcels"."receiver_name", "parcels"."receiver_phone_number", "parcels"."receiver_address", "parcels"."special_notes", "parcels"."delivery_failure_note", "parcels"."township_id", "townships"."name", "parcels"."parcel_type", "parcels"."cod_amount", "parcels"."delivery_fee", "parcels"."weight_kg", "parcels"."parcel_width_cm", "parcels"."parcel_height_cm", "parcels"."parcel_length_cm", "parcels"."proof_of_delivery_images_keys", "parcels"."rider_id", "user"."name", "parcels"."status", "parcels"."created_at" from "parcels" inner join "merchants" on "merchants"."id" = "parcels"."merchant_id" inner join "townships" on "townships"."id" = "parcels"."township_id" left join "riders" on "riders"."id" = "parcels"."rider_id" left join "user" on "user"."id" = "riders"."user_id" where "parcels"."deleted_at" is null

snapshots.name: listMerchantParcelsPageForUser
snapshots.sql: select "parcels"."id", "parcels"."parcel_code", "parcels"."merchant_id", "merchants"."shop_name", "parcels"."receiver_name", "parcels"."receiver_phone_number", "parcels"."receiver_address", "parcels"."special_notes", "parcels"."delivery_failure_note", "parcels"."township_id", "townships"."name", "parcels"."parcel_type", "parcels"."cod_amount", "parcels"."delivery_fee", "parcels"."weight_kg", "parcels"."parcel_width_cm", "parcels"."parcel_height_cm", "parcels"."parcel_length_cm", "parcels"."proof_of_delivery_images_keys", "parcels"."rider_id", "user"."name", "parcels"."status", "parcels"."created_at" from "parcels" inner join "merchants" on "merchants"."id" = "parcels"."merchant_id" inner join "townships" on "townships"."id" = "parcels"."township_id" left join "riders" on "riders"."id" = "parcels"."rider_id" left join "user" on "user"."id" = "riders"."user_id" where ("parcels"."deleted_at" is null and "merchants"."user_id" = $1) order by "parcels"."created_at" desc, "parcels"."parcel_code" desc limit $2

snapshots.name: listEligibleSettlementFinancialItems
snapshots.sql: select "financial_items"."merchant_id", "financial_items"."id" from "financial_items" inner join "merchants" on "merchants"."id" = "financial_items"."merchant_id" left join "parcels" on "parcels"."id" = "financial_items"."parcel_id" where ("financial_items"."merchant_settlement_id" is null and "financial_items"."status" = $1)

snapshots.name: listPendingRiderCashHandovers
snapshots.sql: select "riders"."id", "parcels"."id" from "parcels" inner join "riders" on "riders"."id" = "parcels"."rider_id" where ("parcels"."deleted_at" is null and "parcels"."status" = $1 and "parcels"."is_received_by_office" = $2)

snapshots.sql: select "parcels"."id", "parcels"."parcel_code", "parcels"."merchant_id", "merchants"."shop_name", "parcels"."receiver_name", "parcels"."receiver_phone_number", "parcels"."receiver_address", "parcels"."special_notes", "parcels"."delivery_failure_note", "parcels"."township_id", "townships"."name", "parcels"."parcel_type", "parcels"."cod_amount", "parcels"."delivery_fee", "parcels"."weight_kg", "parcels"."parcel_width_cm", "parcels"."parcel_height_cm", "parcels"."parcel_length_cm", "parcels"."proof_of_delivery_images_keys", "parcels"."rider_id", "user"."name", "parcels"."status", "parcels"."created_at" from "parcels" inner join "merchants" on "merchants"."id" = "parcels"."merchant_id" inner join "townships" on "townships"."id" = "parcels"."township_id" left join "riders" on "riders"."id" = "parcels"."rider_id" left join "user" on "user"."id" = "riders"."user_id" where ("parcels"."deleted_at" is null and "riders"."user_id" = $1)
